text_block_list.text:
Spotting Tamamo Cross ahead on the path, 
she gazes back this way with a somewhat 
anxious look. As if to give her a gentle 
push forward—
choice_data_list: Go on, tell them how you really feel

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like she's moved past it. She ran 
a great race at the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Though honestly, I still don't get it. Did 
she move on 'cause she faced it head-on, 
or is she relieved 'cause she gave up...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What do you run for? Did ya finally find 
an answer to that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still... I just want to run. Run, run, and 
run—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I want to win. I don't want to lose to 
anyone. Not even to you...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's enough. Now—I'll pour 
everything into my run!
